params.prompt: A memory-like image in faded, washed-out colours like an old pencil and watercolour drawing: at dusk at the end of a harbour pier, the lone silhouette of a woman in a long red coat with the hood up, seen from behind, standing still and looking out at the sea; her face and hair are not visible; only the red coat keeps its colour, everything else is soft sepia and pale blue. Quiet and a little mysterious, not sad, not scary. Vertical composition. Warm animated-series illustration, graphic-novel style, clean ink lines, soft cel shading, coastal palette of sea blue, sand, lighthouse yellow and evening orange, mature tone suitable for teens and adults, not childish, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
